hotel-apartment-end-to-end-guest-journey.Evidence: Check the reservation promises, early-arrival requests, cot requirements, access setup, inspection status and Engineering holds against current property records.
hotel-apartment-end-to-end-guest-journey.Decision: Decide which guest commitments can be confirmed, which need an approved alternative and which must remain pending until the responsible department verifies readiness.
hotel-apartment-end-to-end-guest-journey.Action: Assign the missing cot setup and maintenance dependency to named owners; update the arrival brief and communicate only confirmed arrangements to the guest.
hotel-apartment-end-to-end-guest-journey.Verification: Confirm inspection and authorised apartment release, verify the requested setup and access handover, and keep unresolved guest commitments open.

hotel-apartment-operations-control-tower.Evidence: Check the arrival plan, Engineering holds, guest commitments, critical stock, overdue work orders and staff availability against their source records.
hotel-apartment-operations-control-tower.Decision: Prioritise exceptions by guest impact, safety, dependency and decision deadline; challenge conflicting statuses before authorising an intervention.
hotel-apartment-operations-control-tower.Action: Assign each priority exception an accountable department owner, next action, escalation threshold and review time in the shared control queue.
hotel-apartment-operations-control-tower.Verification: Reconcile each changed status with its source evidence and confirm that the guest commitment or operating constraint has actually been resolved.

hotel-front-office-ai-toolkit.Evidence: Check PMS arrival records, room inspections, Engineering close-out, approved early-access terms, guest setup requests and any booked transfer confirmations.
hotel-front-office-ai-toolkit.Decision: Decide which arrivals are ready, dependent, unverified or requests without guaranteed entitlement; keep room release and guest promises with the authorised owner.
hotel-front-office-ai-toolkit.Action: Assign the outstanding room, cot and transfer confirmations to the responsible departments and update the arrival brief with owners and review deadlines.
hotel-front-office-ai-toolkit.Verification: Confirm authorised room release, required setups and verified service confirmations; reconcile the front-office handover before closing each arrival dependency.

hotel-general-manager-ai-toolkit.Evidence: Check occupancy and pickup reports, VIP commitments, out-of-order units, recurring AC complaints, overdue payment records and staffing gaps with the relevant department owners.
hotel-general-manager-ai-toolkit.Decision: Prioritise decisions by guest impact, operating risk, financial exposure and deadline; retain departmental decision rights and escalate only within the approved authority.
hotel-general-manager-ai-toolkit.Action: Assign each management priority a decision owner, supporting evidence, approved action and review time; record unresolved assumptions in the management brief.
hotel-general-manager-ai-toolkit.Verification: Confirm the responsible department has completed the agreed action and test the operating result against source records before reporting the priority as resolved.

hotel-guest-experience-quality-managemen.Evidence: Check feedback and complaint records against stay dates, apartment IDs, readiness inspections, HVAC work orders and service-recovery records.
hotel-guest-experience-quality-managemen.Decision: Decide whether the arrival or comfort signals indicate a recurring process problem; separate an evidenced cause from an untested hypothesis.
hotel-guest-experience-quality-managemen.Action: Assign immediate guest recovery and the cause investigation to named owners, with correction deadlines and a defined recurrence check.
hotel-guest-experience-quality-managemen.Verification: Review subsequent stays, inspections and complaint records for the same failure pattern; document the evidence before claiming improved guest experience.

hotel-housekeeping-management-ai-toolkit.Evidence: Check cleaned, inspected and authorised-release statuses separately, along with open AC work orders, required setups, DND restrictions and usable linen stock.
hotel-housekeeping-management-ai-toolkit.Decision: Decide which apartments meet the approved release criteria and which remain blocked by inspection, technical, access or inventory dependencies.
hotel-housekeeping-management-ai-toolkit.Action: Coordinate the outstanding inspections, Engineering close-out and setup work with named owners; retain approved DND and guest-access boundaries.
hotel-housekeeping-management-ai-toolkit.Verification: Reinspect corrected items and confirm authorised release against the room record; nine apartments marked cleaned must not be reported as nine ready apartments.

hotel-housekeeping-quality-control.Evidence: Check the 48 inspection records, 10 rework cases and 17 defect observations against the apartment, task, shift and inspection criteria used in the example.
hotel-housekeeping-quality-control.Decision: Decide which defect patterns warrant cause investigation, targeted coaching or a workload adjustment; do not infer the cause from the first-pass percentage alone.
hotel-housekeeping-quality-control.Action: Assign defect corrections and a focused improvement trial with owners, acceptance criteria and a follow-up inspection sample.
hotel-housekeeping-quality-control.Verification: Reinspect failed items and compare a clearly defined subsequent sample for first-pass quality and recurrence; keep illustrative figures separate from actual property results.

hotel-housekeeping-standardization.Evidence: Check observed cleaning sequences, apartment condition, supply locations, task times and inspection outcomes before comparing attendants.
hotel-housekeeping-standardization.Decision: Decide which variation can be removed through a standard work sequence and which reflects legitimate apartment condition or guest requirements.
hotel-housekeeping-standardization.Action: Test the revised sequence and supply arrangement with attendants and supervisors; retain exception handling and quality acceptance criteria.
hotel-housekeeping-standardization.Verification: Observe the revised work and compare equivalent apartment conditions and inspection quality; do not treat identical cleaning times as proof of improvement.

hotel-operations-planning-daily-control.Evidence: Check the 22 arrivals, 19 departures, early-arrival requests, Engineering holds and special setups against current PMS, inspection and department records.
hotel-operations-planning-daily-control.Decision: Decide which arrival commitments are at risk and which approved resource allocation or departmental decision can remove the readiness constraint.
hotel-operations-planning-daily-control.Action: Assign the apartment readiness and setup dependencies to named owners with clear completion and escalation times in the daily operating plan.
hotel-operations-planning-daily-control.Verification: Check actual readiness against the agreed arrival commitments and confirm each departmental handover before closing the daily exception.

hotel-reservations-ai-toolkit.Evidence: Check the booking IDs, PMS confirmation, current corporate contract, billing scope, early-arrival terms and supplier confirmation for requested airport pickup.
hotel-reservations-ai-toolkit.Decision: Decide which items are confirmed, conflicting, unverified or possible duplicates; do not cancel a booking or promise an inclusion without authorised verification.
hotel-reservations-ai-toolkit.Action: Route contract conflicts to Reservations and Sales, billing scope to Finance and pickup confirmation to Transport; record the owner and deadline for each pending item.
hotel-reservations-ai-toolkit.Verification: Reconcile the final booking record with approved terms and confirmations, retain the duplicate-review evidence and verify the reservation handover before guest communication.

hotel-workforce-productivity-efficiency.Evidence: Check departures, stayovers, arrivals, task-time assumptions, paid versus productive hours, breaks, travel, inspections, skills and staff availability.
hotel-workforce-productivity-efficiency.Decision: Decide whether the proposed staffing covers the full service workload and required skills; 29.5 direct task hours alone cannot determine an eight-hour-shift roster.
hotel-workforce-productivity-efficiency.Action: Build the workload-adjusted staffing plan with approved task standards, non-task time, quality checks and named coverage for remaining gaps.
hotel-workforce-productivity-efficiency.Verification: Compare planned and actual workload, completed service and inspection quality; review overtime and unmet work before claiming a productivity gain.

workforce-rostering-productivity-ai-tool.Evidence: Check departures, arrivals, stayover demand, task standards, skill coverage, employee availability and approved shift constraints rather than occupancy alone.
workforce-rostering-productivity-ai-tool.Decision: Decide whether the roster can cover the forecast workload and required skills without reducing service quality or overriding applicable employment rules.
workforce-rostering-productivity-ai-tool.Action: Prepare the workload-based roster for the authorised reviewer and record coverage gaps, assumptions and agreed contingency arrangements.
workforce-rostering-productivity-ai-tool.Verification: Review actual workload, service completion, quality, overtime and remaining coverage gaps against the approved roster before reporting improved productivity.
